name: short ton (US ton)
definition: 2000 lb. Default meaning of 'ton' for US bulk materials; always state the qualifier.

name: ton of refrigeration (cooling capacity)
definition: HVAC cooling capacity: 12,000 Btu/h. Not convertible to mass units.

name: US liquid gallon
definition: 231 in^3 = 3.785411784 L. Default for US paints, coatings, adhesives.

name: imperial gallon
definition: 4.54609 L. Not used for US products; present to detect mislabelled data.

name: hour
definition: Context must say person-hour, crew-hour or equipment-hour; stored in separate fields, never mixed.

name: work day / shift
factor_formula: DAY = shift_hours HR (shift length is a per-crew parameter)
definition: Not a fixed number of hours. Convert only through crews.shift_hours.
